tradeoff: The 256 cutoff is tied to one radix histogram width, not asserted to be a universal crossover. Sizes255/256 return to base performance from first roughly0.765; ordered small inputs again allocate at most1KiB scratch before mutation, as M0 did. Sizes257/512/4096 retain radix and measured gains. Both source changes remain reversible; no semantic or gate changes.
